# Open Mic Repository Instructions

Use [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) as the repository's primary guidance. Keep the planning documents, API contract, and recorded decisions aligned.

When documents disagree, do not silently choose an interpretation. Report the conflict and ask which source should win unless the correction is an obvious typo, malformed syntax, broken link, or unambiguous omission.

Before completing documentation work, run the narrowest relevant validation command from `AGENTS.md` and report any pre-existing findings separately from new issues.
